object.name: evi.clipasym~
object.description: Vaguely inspired by the nonlinear part of the K35 chip in the Korg MS10 filter. This has similar asymmetric nonlinear behaviour. The anti-aliasing here is not as successful as in other evieve objects, so be careful not to drive it too hard.

inlets.description: The amount of asymmetry in the distortion signal.

attributes.name: bounds
attributes.description: If on (the default), output is attenuated so that full range input does not go out of bounds. If off, there is no protection, but often this is not needed anyway.

attributes.name: nonlin
attributes.description: Select the internal nonlinearity used. 0=cubic (more Korg-like), 1=tanh (harder).

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Optionally smooth the the internal coefficients calculations. Turn this off (0) if audio rate modulating inlet 2 ('Asymmetry')
